$comment: Definition library: validate against the explicit named $defs entry, not the empty library root. Parameters and legacy leaves have the documented open grammars.

CommandStep.$comment: D023-2: expected_code_sha256 is always present and nullable. In evaluation mode (ExecutionSpec.prepared_ref non-null and the frozen recipe declares OperationRecipe.code_sha256) it MUST equal prepared.recipe.code_sha256. In ordinary command mode (V05 null set) it MUST be null. The schema enforces presence and form only; the equality and mode rules are V32.

OperationRecipe.$comment: D023-2: code_sha256 is the frozen expected code identity for the supported entrypoint/package scope. It is not the digest of an archived interpreter. Apps copies it unchanged into every CommandStep.expected_code_sha256 under evaluation mode.

PreparedEvaluation.$comment: D023-1: the archived prepared bytes plus, in process, the frozen protocol bytes and a read-only per-role resource closure reader are delivered outside this object. This object remains the exact frozen record; no storage location or archive handle is added here.

RuntimeBinding.$comment: D023-2: code_sha256 is the observed actual entrypoint/package digest. It is compared against CommandStep.expected_code_sha256 and the frozen recipe before any candidate process starts; it must never be filled with the expected value when the actual bytes could not be resolved.

DeliveredContext.$comment: D023-3: this is the sealed, committed delivery record. It is published only after H has retained the actual delivered bytes through its own capture/commit route, so its artifact is a Ref to retained bytes and never a Ref to not-yet-committed bytes. The pre-commit value handed back by ContextProvider.collect is a PROCESS-LOCAL DeliveredContextDraft (items/selection/omissions/limitations, bytes or stream, proposed logical location and digest); it is deliberately not a JSON DTO definition and must not be given a fake serialized stream shape.

AppsExecuteRequest.$comment: D023-5: attempt is mandatory and is the pre-allocated AttemptContext. execute never calls allocate_attempt itself. StorageConfig is injected by a trusted host or an explicit --storage-config file and is deliberately absent from every Apps*Request.

AppsAssessRequest.$comment: D023-4: primary_scope and primary_claim_id are mandatory and identify one exact claim key frozen in the protocol. An unknown key or a missing legal primary key is InvalidRequest before the assessor is called; a key present in the protocol but absent from the B result is an AssessorError-class result-contract error, never an Apps user-argument error. Key resolution order is V34.

AppsResultV1.$comment: D023-4: primary_claim_id, primary_scope, exit_code and error are mandatory fields and may not be dropped. Inner/outer Ref and admission consistency are governed by D022 with V30 and V34: a failed archive keeps any in-memory assessment but forces assessment_ref null, and no result field may be invented from request declarations.
